Q1:
SELECT d.year, c.county_name, count(*) AS collisions, sum(f.killed) AS killed, sum(f.injured) AS injured
FROM dw.fact_collision f
JOIN dw.dim_date d   ON d.date_key = f.date_key
JOIN dw.dim_county c ON c.county_key = f.county_key
GROUP BY d.year, c.county_name
ORDER BY d.year, collisions DESC
Q2:
SELECT t.time_band, x.lighting, x.road_surface, d.is_weekend, count(*) AS collisions
FROM dw.fact_collision f
JOIN dw.dim_time t    ON t.time_key = f.time_key
JOIN dw.dim_context x ON x.context_key = f.context_key
JOIN dw.dim_date d    ON d.date_key = f.date_key
WHERE d.year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2020
GROUP BY t.time_band, x.lighting, x.road_surface, d.is_weekend
ORDER BY collisions DESC, t.time_band, x.lighting, x.road_surface, d.is_weekend
LIMIT 20
Q3:
WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT c.county_name, d.year, count(*) AS collisions
  FROM dw.fact_collision f
  JOIN dw.dim_date d   ON d.date_key = f.date_key
  JOIN dw.dim_county c ON c.county_key = f.county_key
  WHERE d.year BETWEEN 2001 AND 2020
  GROUP BY c.county_name, d.year
)
SELECT county_name, year, collisions,
       rank() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY collisions DESC) AS rank_in_year,
       collisions - lag(collisions) OVER (PARTITION BY county_name ORDER BY year) AS change_vs_prev_year
FROM yearly
ORDER BY year, rank_in_year
Q4:
SELECT c.county_name, d.year, count(*) AS collisions, p.population,
       round(100000.0 * count(*) / NULLIF(p.population,0), 1) AS per_100k
FROM dw.fact_collision f
JOIN dw.dim_date d   ON d.date_key = f.date_key
JOIN dw.dim_county c ON c.county_key = f.county_key
JOIN dw.fact_population_annual p ON p.county_key = f.county_key AND p.year_key = d.year
WHERE d.year BETWEEN 2005 AND 2020
GROUP BY c.county_name, d.year, p.population
ORDER BY per_100k DESC NULLS LAST, c.county_name, d.year
LIMIT 20
Q5:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT d.year, d.month, count(*) AS collisions, sum(f.killed) AS killed
  FROM dw.fact_collision f
  JOIN dw.dim_date d   ON d.date_key = f.date_key
  JOIN dw.dim_county c ON c.county_key = f.county_key
  WHERE c.county_name = 'Los Angeles County' AND d.year <= 2020
  GROUP BY d.year, d.month
)
SELECT year, month, collisions,
       round(avg(collisions) OVER (ORDER BY year, month ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS moving_avg_12m,
       sum(killed) OVER (ORDER BY year, month) AS cumulative_killed
FROM m
ORDER BY year, month
